results.rationale: We have recent solar energy deployments (CAP-032/008/044) consistent with design/supply/installation, but the summaries do not evidence net-metering approvals and explicit 3-year O&M for grid-tied PV.

Hospital IT deployment experience suggests capability to conduct site surveys and engineering activities, but there is no direct evidence of site survey and detailed engineering design work for hospital solar PV installations.
Solar project records indicate PV system supply as part of deployments, but they do not confirm Tier-1 module/inverter brands or compliance explicitly.

We have infrastructure project experience and a solar deployment record, but there is no explicit evidence of performing the required civil and electrical installation works for PV projects (and CO-PROFILE shows no PEC constructor registration).
No provided capability record or profile evidence demonstrates SCADA-based remote monitoring with a central dashboard for solar PV systems.
Solar deployment experience is relevant, but none of the summaries explicitly mention liaison with DISCOs or obtaining net-metering licenses/approvals.
Hospital IT deployments make staff training plausible, but the evidence does not explicitly state training of hospital engineering staff as a delivered scope item.
CO-PROFILE indicates an in-country support model and preventive maintenance offerings, but there is no explicit evidence of comprehensive solar PV O&M with performance guarantees for three years.
